title: Page 9
slug: 仇人逼我嫁-芳妮-孟佳梨没想到当年老被她保护的小胖子竟变成眼前的帅哥总裁-他曾发誓以后换他保护她可现在欺负她最狠的就是他
content_zh:
“护短。”孟佳梨好笑的嗔道，心头像沁了蜜般甜滋滋。

“我承认。”他深情瞅着她，语气一转，低声道：“对不起。”他不该不信任她。

孟佳梨摇摇头，举起手指抵在他的唇瓣上，“互不相欠了。”

“不，我欠你一辈子。”耿柏恩低下头，深深吻住了她的唇瓣。

一滴泪缓缓滑过孟佳梨脸颊，这次却是因为幸福满溢而流下的喜悦之泪。

“欸，你不要靠这么近好吗？走开一点啦。”

“汪汪汪——汪汪！”

“好啦好啦，坐好再给你。”

“汪汪！”

“啊！救命啊——”

孟佳梨躺在院子的躺椅上，看着狗儿扑倒耿安茜，抢走了她手上的鸡肉干，忍不住咧开了嘴，朝摇着尾巴的狗儿喊了声，“宝宝，不可以欺负姑姑喔。”

“汪汪——”狗儿朝她的方向汪了几声，随即又继续扑倒耿安茜。

“啊，你这疯狗，走开啦——”耿安茜继续尖叫。

“宝宝真是的，越来越不听我的话了。”孟佳梨无奈的准备撑起身体，却被走近的耿柏恩给按住了。

他给了孟佳梨一个“看我的”的表情，随即朝狗儿简短的喊了声。“宝宝！”

只见那金黄色的躯体马上停止了动作，乖乖的坐正身子，朝耿柏恩“哈哈”吐舌，露出像是在笑的表情。

“欸，这家伙也太狗腿了吧？”孟佳梨没好气的白了狗儿子一眼，心里真是大大不平衡啊。

“他知道谁才是主人。”耿柏恩得意的笑笑。

“才怪，是因为你每天晚上贡献的那根猪大骨吧。”她早就知道每天晚上他都会趁她睡着之后拨时间去跟宝宝“秉烛夜谈”，有时笑声连她在房间都听得到。

“为了博取它妈妈的欢心，我只好先讨好它了。”耿柏恩也不否认，他知道狗儿在孟佳梨心目中的地位，自然不敢怠慢。

“我怎么都不知道你这么会说甜言蜜语？”孟佳梨忍不住轻笑出声。

“就怕你以后会听腻。”耿柏恩在躺椅上坐下，将她揽在怀中，温柔的凝视着她，目光在她一点都没有增胖，甚至看起来好像更加消瘦的苍白脸庞梭巡着，然后移到了她隆起的肚子上，眼中染上点点担忧，突然轻叹了声，“我不该答应你的。”

“我很好。”孟佳梨拉着他的手覆在自己的肚子上，脸上洋溢着成为母亲的慈蔼光辉，“我从来没有像现在这么确定过。”

当时他们虽然确认了彼此的感情，但正因为如此，耿柏恩更加强烈的反对她保有孩子，试图说服他雨个人的世界比有孩子的生活更加多采多姿，极力想劝她将孩子拿掉。

可惜他太低估她对孩子的爱与执着，她宁愿冒着生命危险，也绝不愿放弃这个小生命，尤其这还是他们俩一起制造的爱情结晶。

她因此跟他冷战了好几天，最后他还是屈服了，不甘愿的支持了她的决定。

“我不能失去你。”想起整个孕程中，随着胎儿逐渐长大，她身体的负荷也更为沉重，有好几次昏厥送医的经历，他每次都忍不住胆颤心惊，深怕哪一天她就不会再醒来。

“不会的。”她紧紧拥住他，好像要给他力量，也像在说服自己，“你不但不会失去我，还会多个可爱的女儿，你瞧，这不是很划算吗？”她故作轻松的道。

耿柏恩知道她心中的不安其实并不会比他少，却一直表现得坚强无惧，好淡化他的焦虑，顿时心疼了起来，轻抚着她的眉眼，柔声道：“我今天有告诉过你，我好爱你吗？”

孟佳梨摇摇头，迎视着他深情的黑眸，微微一晒，“现在说也不迟。”

“孟佳梨，我爱你，生生世世，唯你一人。”他俯下头，温柔的在她耳边低喃。

“我也爱你，我的傻瓜耿柏恩。”孟佳梨觉得整颗心被温暖的情意涨得满满的，将脸在他坚实的胸膛上磨蹭着。

“啧啧啧，你们两个真是太肉麻了，我跟宝宝都看不下去了，臭狗，我们还是闪远点，走，姑姑再去拿鸡肉干给你。”耿安茜佯装用手遮住了眼睛，边摇头边往屋内走，好掩饰眸底的湿意。

“汪汪——”狗儿听到有吃的，耳朵瞬间竖了竖，随即蹦蹦跳跳的跟在耿安茜身旁。

“小茜。”孟佳梨喊住了她，给了她一个大大的笑容，轻声道：“谢谢你。”

她知道耿安茜其实没那么喜欢狗，但怕她大肚子不方便照顾狗儿，所以只要有空就帮她陪狗儿玩，让她不至于因为怀孕忽略狗儿而感到亏欠。

“不用了，就当我之前做错事的惩罚好了。”她不以为意的挥挥手，顿了顿，又道：“不过，你若是真要谢我，就平安生下我的侄女吧，大嫂。”说完，不等孟佳梨反应，就带着狗儿往屋内快速走了进去。

虽然她对孟佳梨还没有多深厚的感情，但耿、孟两家的恩怨也算告一段落了，加上看到孟佳梨为了孩子不惜赌上生命，好几次危急到得进医院安胎也无怨无悔，她还是很感动的，对孟佳梨也逐渐改观，默默的接受她成为自己的大嫂了。

“你听到了吗？她叫我大嫂了！”孟佳梨感动得眼眶瞬间泛红，这是小茜第一次开口叫她大嫂。

“她早该这么做了。”耿柏恩也感染了她的喜悦，怜爱的抚去她飘上脸颊的青丝。

“柏恩，我真的好幸福好幸福，等爸的身体更稳定些，那我这辈子就没有遗憾了。”在她跟耿柏恩和好之后，她父亲就回去继续治疗，耿柏恩也多聘了几个贴身看护照顾他，让她可以安心在台湾待产。等她生完孩子，父亲这次的疗程应该也差不多结束了，一切似乎是这么的美好，美好得让她有点害怕。

“胡说，这辈子还长得很，我还要带你去环游世界呢。”这句话让耿桕恩的心不由得打了个突，莫名的不安又开始在内心深处蠢动了起来。

“对喔，现在说这个好像还太早，真是该罚。”孟佳梨发现耿柏恩眸底突然闪过的忧虑，既心疼又愧疚。如果不是自己的身体这么差，他也不用跟着担心受怕。

“我赞成。”耿柏恩轻喃，低头深深吻住了她的唇瓣，好像这样才能确认她存在，贪婪的索取着属于她的气息与温度。

孟佳梨热切的响应着他，那份悸动一如往昔，不，甚至比往昔更加让她醉心，任由自己飘荡在他用爱筑起的世界，安心徜徉。

“啊！”突然她惊呼了声，耿柏恩的心一下子提到了喉头，紧张的松开了她的唇瓣，快速的查看着她的状况。

“我送你去医院。”她的脸庞泛着异常的红量，让耿柏恩忧心忡忡，双手往她身上一捞，就要抱着她起身。

孟佳梨摇摇头，阻止他继续动作，抓住他的手往自己的小腹放，柔声道：“我没事，是孩子在踢我。”怀孕快八个月了，这个孩子的动作越来越频繁，每一次都让她感到惊喜。

耿柏恩紧绷的神色这才微微松了松，大掌贴在那隆起的弧度上，眸底同时染上了喜色，嘴上却是不满的斥喝，“这小家伙太顽皮了，真以为你的肚子是她的运动场了？等她出来，我非要好好打她屁股，教讯教1副她不可。”

“行行行，就怕你到时候舍不得打，说不定连我的地位都会一落千丈。”孟佳梨打趣道。她知道虽然他曾经要她舍弃这个孩子，但其实内心深处，他比任何人还要高兴这个孩子的存在，尤其当他知道怀的是女儿时，连睡觉都在偷笑呢。
content_en:
"Guard your shortcomings." Meng Jiali said in a funny tone, her heart feeling as sweet as honey.

"I admit it." He looked at her affectionately, changed his tone, and whispered: "I'm sorry." He shouldn't distrust her.

Meng Jiali shook her head, raised her finger and put it against his lips, "We don't owe each other anymore."

"No, I owe you my whole life." Bowen Bowen lowered his head and kissed her lips deeply.

A tear slowly slid down Meng Jiali's cheek, but this time it was tears of joy shed because of overflowing happiness.

"Hey, please don't get so close, okay? Move away a little bit."

"Woof woof woof - woof woof!"

"Okay, okay, sit down and I'll give it to you."

"Woof woof!"

"Ah! Help-"

Meng Jiali was lying on the couch in the yard, watching the dog knock down Geng Anxi and snatch the chicken jerky from her hand. She couldn't help but grinned and shouted to the dog wagging its tail, "Baby, you can't bully aunt."

"Woof woof—" the dog barked several times in her direction, and then continued to pounce on Geng Anxi.

"Ah, you crazy dog, go away -" Geng Anxi continued to scream.

"The baby is really disobeying me less and less." Meng Jiali reluctantly prepared to prop up her body, but was held down by Geng Bo'en who came closer.

He gave Meng Jiali a "look at me" look, and then gave a brief shout to the dog."Baby!"

The golden body immediately stopped moving, sat upright obediently, and "haha" stuck out its tongue at Geng Bo'en, showing an expression that seemed to be smiling.

"Hey, isn't this guy too lazy?" Meng Jiali rolled her eyes at the dog son angrily, feeling really unbalanced.

"He knows who is the master." Geng Bo'en smiled proudly.

"That's weird, it must be because of the big pig bone you contributed every night." She had known for a long time that every night after she fell asleep, he would take the time to "talk by candlelight" with the baby, and sometimes her laughter could even be heard in the room.

"In order to win the favor of its mother, I had to please it first." Geng Bo'en did not deny it. He knew the dog's status in Meng Jiali's heart, so naturally he did not dare to neglect it.

"I never knew you were so good at sweet words?" Meng Jiali couldn't help but chuckle.

"I'm afraid you'll get tired of hearing about it in the future." Geng Bo'en sat down on the recliner, held her in his arms, and stared at her tenderly. His eyes wandered over her pale face, which had not gained any weight at all, and even looked thinner, and then moved to her swollen belly. There was a little worry in his eyes, and he suddenly sighed softly, "I shouldn't have promised you."

"I'm fine." Meng Jiali took his hand and put it on her belly, her face filled with the kindness of becoming a mother. "I have never been so sure as now."

Although they confirmed their feelings for each other at that time, because of this, Geng Boen was more strongly opposed to her keeping the child, trying to convince him that her personal world was more colorful than life with children, and tried his best to persuade her to get rid of the child.

It's a pity that he underestimated her love and persistence for her child. She would rather risk her life than give up this little life, especially since it was the fruit of their love together.

She had a cold war with him for several days, but finally he gave in and reluctantly supported her decision.

"I can't lose you." Thinking of the entire pregnancy, as the fetus gradually grew, the load on her body became heavier, and she fainted and was sent to the hospital several times. He couldn't help but feel frightened every time, fearing that one day she would not wake up again.

"No." She hugged him tightly, as if to give him strength, but also to convince herself, "Not only will you not lose me, but you will also have many lovely daughters. Look, isn't this a good deal?" She said pretending to be relaxed.

Geng Bo'en knew that she was no less uneasy than him, but he always acted strong and fearless to downplay his anxiety. He suddenly felt distressed, caressing her eyebrows, and said softly: "Did I tell you today that I love you so much?"

Meng Jiali shook her head, looked into his affectionate black eyes, and smiled slightly, "It's not too late to say it now."

"Meng Jiali, I love you, and I will love you only for the rest of my life." He lowered his head and whispered softly into her ear.

"I love you too, my fool Gunn." Meng Jiali felt her whole heart swelled with warm affection and rubbed her face against his solid chest.

"Tsk, tsk, tsk, you two are so disgusting, the baby and I can't stand it any longer. You stinky dog, let's stay away. Let's go. Auntie will get some chicken jerky for you." Geng Anqian pretended to cover her eyes with her hands, and walked into the house while shaking her head to hide the wetness in her eyes.

"Woof woof -" When the dog heard that there was food, his ears perked up instantly, and then he jumped up and followed Geng Anqian.

"Xiao Qian." Meng Jiali stopped her, gave her a big smile, and said softly: "Thank you."

She knew that Geng Anxi didn't really like dogs that much, but she was afraid that her big belly would make it difficult to take care of the dog, so she helped her play with the dog whenever she had time, so that she wouldn't feel indebted for neglecting the dog while pregnant.

"No, just treat it as punishment for what I did wrong before." She waved her hand nonchalantly, paused, and then said, "But if you really want to thank me, just give birth to my niece safely, sister-in-law." After saying that, without waiting for Meng Jiali's reaction, she quickly walked into the house with her dog.

Although she didn't have deep feelings for Meng Jiali yet, the grudge between the Geng and Meng families had come to an end. In addition, she was still very moved when she saw that Meng Jiali was willing to risk her life for the sake of her child and had to go to the hospital for abortion several times without any regrets. She gradually changed her view of Meng Jiali and silently accepted her as her sister-in-law.

"Did you hear that? She called me sister-in-law!" Meng Jiali was so moved that her eyes instantly turned red. This was the first time Xiao Qian called her sister-in-law.

"She should have done this a long time ago." Geng Bo'en was also infected with her joy, lovingly stroking away the black hair floating on her cheeks.

"Born, I am so happy. When dad's body becomes more stable, I will have no regrets in this life." After she reconciled with Geng Bowen, her father went back to continue treatment. Geng Bowen also hired a few more personal nurses to take care of him, so that she could wait for the birth in Taiwan with peace of mind.After she gave birth to the baby, her father's treatment should be almost over. Everything seemed so beautiful, so beautiful that it scared her a little.

"Nonsense, you still have a long life in this life, and I will take you to travel around the world." These words made Geng Gao'en's heart suddenly tremble, and the inexplicable uneasiness began to stir deep in his heart.

"Yes, it seems too early to say this now. You really deserve to be punished." Meng Jiali noticed the sudden worry flashing in Geng Boen's eyes, and felt both distressed and guilty.If his health hadn't been so bad, he wouldn't have had to worry about it.

"I agree." Geng Bo'en murmured softly, lowered his head and kissed her lips deeply, as if this could confirm her existence, greedily seeking her breath and warmth.

Meng Jiali responded to him eagerly, the throbbing feeling was the same as before, no, even more intoxicating than before. She let herself drift in the world he built with love, wandering with peace of mind.

"Ah!" Suddenly she exclaimed, and Bowen's heart suddenly rose to his throat. He nervously let go of her lips and quickly checked her condition.

"I'll take you to the hospital." Her face was unusually red, which made Geng Bo'en worried. He reached for her with both hands and tried to hold her up.

Meng Jiali shook her head to stop him from continuing, grabbed his hand and put it on her belly, saying softly: "I'm fine, the baby is kicking me." She was almost eight months pregnant, and the baby's movements became more and more frequent, and she was surprised every time.

Geng Bo'en's tense expression relaxed slightly. His big palm was placed on the bulging curve. His eyes were filled with joy at the same time, but his mouth was dissatisfied and scolded, "This little guy is so naughty. Do you really think your belly is her playground? When she comes out, I will spank her well and teach her a lesson."

"Okay, okay, I'm afraid that if you don't want to fight me then, maybe even my status will plummet." Meng Jiali joked.She knew that although he once asked her to give up this child, deep down in his heart, he was happier than anyone else for the existence of this child, especially when he knew that he was pregnant with a daughter, he was laughing even in his sleep.
